title: keystore non-atomic write: temp+rename
description: wp11_keystore_create opens the final path with O_CREAT|O_TRUNC and writes header, ciphertext, and tag in three separate write_all calls. A process kill between any two writes leaves a partial file at the final path. On next load, the partial file fails the GCM auth tag check, which returns WP11_KEYSTORE_ERR_CRYPTO — exposed to the caller as a BAD_PIN or generic IO error depending on the code path. The actual cause (truncated file) is indistinguishable from a wrong PIN. Fix: write to a temp file in the same directory, fsync, then rename(2) to atomically replace the destination. Regression: add a test that kills the write mid-stream and verifies load returns ERR_CORRUPT (not ERR_BAD_PIN).
